description:
The Gaurav Puraskar Award is a prestigious recognition established by the Government of India to honor exemplary contributions in various fields. 

The award was initiated in the year 2018. 

It aims to acknowledge and celebrate the achievements of individuals and organizations that have made significant impacts in their respective domains. 

The Gaurav Puraskar Award specifically focuses on contributions in the fields of education, health, environment, and social service. 

The primary objective of the award is to promote a culture of excellence and inspire others to contribute positively to society. 

The award seeks to identify and reward individuals who have demonstrated outstanding commitment and service to the community. 

The Gaurav Puraskar Award is presented annually. 

The award ceremony typically takes place on the occasion of National Youth Day, celebrated on January 12 each year. 

The award consists of a certificate of appreciation and a monetary prize. 

The monetary prize awarded is ₹1,00,000. 

In addition to the cash prize, recipients receive a trophy that symbolizes their achievement. 

The eligibility criteria for the Gaurav Puraskar Award are clearly defined. 

Individuals from all walks of life can apply for the award. 

There are no specific age limits for applicants. 

However, applicants must demonstrate a proven track record of contributions in their field. 

Organizations can also be nominated for the award. 

To be eligible, organizations must have been operational for a minimum of three years. 

The contributions made by the nominees must be verifiable and impactful. 

The application process for the Gaurav Puraskar Award involves several steps. 

Interested individuals or organizations must submit a detailed application form. 

The application form can be obtained from the official website of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

Along with the application form, applicants must provide supporting documents. 

These documents may include proof of achievements, testimonials, and any relevant certificates. 

The application must be submitted before the deadline, which is usually set for November 30 each year. 

After the submission of applications, a selection committee reviews the nominations. 

The selection committee comprises experts from various fields. 

They evaluate the contributions based on predefined criteria. 

The committee's decision is final and is announced during the award ceremony. 

The Gaurav Puraskar Award has seen a growing number of applications since its inception. 

In the first year, 2018, there were approximately 150 nominations received. 

By 2022, this number had increased to over 500 nominations. 

This growth indicates a rising awareness and interest in the award among the youth and community leaders. 

The award has been instrumental in motivating individuals to engage in social work. 

It has also encouraged organizations to enhance their community service initiatives. 

The implementing authority for the Gaurav Puraskar Award is the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

The ministry is responsible for promoting youth development and welfare in India. 

For inquiries regarding the award, individuals can contact the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports at their official office. 

The contact number for the ministry is 011-2338-1556. 

The official website provides additional information and updates regarding the award. 

The website URL is https://youthaffairs.gov.in. 

The Gaurav Puraskar Award not only recognizes individual achievements but also serves as a platform for sharing best practices. 

It encourages recipients to mentor others in their communities. 

The award aims to create a ripple effect of positive change across the nation. 

In addition to the monetary prize, the recognition helps recipients gain visibility. 

This visibility can lead to further opportunities for collaboration and support. 

The award is part of a broader initiative by the Indian government to foster a spirit of volunteerism among the youth. 

It aligns with the vision of creating a more engaged and responsible citizenry. 

The Gaurav Puraskar Award has been covered extensively in various media outlets. 

This coverage has helped raise awareness about the contributions of the recipients. 

It has also highlighted the importance of community service in nation-building. 

The award serves as a reminder of the potential impact that individuals can have on society. 

The Gaurav Puraskar Award is a valuable addition to the array of government initiatives aimed at empowering citizens. 

It reflects the government's commitment to recognizing and supporting those who strive for social betterment. 

The award continues to evolve, with plans for expanding its reach and impact in the coming years. 

Future editions may include additional categories to recognize diverse contributions. 

The Gaurav Puraskar Award stands as a testament to the spirit of service and excellence in India. 

It encourages a culture of recognition that inspires future generations to contribute positively. 

The award is a significant step towards acknowledging the unsung heroes of society. 

It plays a crucial role in promoting social responsibility among the youth. 

The Gaurav Puraskar Award is more than just an accolade; it is a movement towards a better society. 

Through this initiative, the government aims to create a legacy of service and excellence. 

The award symbolizes hope and inspiration for many aspiring changemakers across the country. 

In conclusion, the Gaurav Puraskar Award is a vital initiative that recognizes and rewards outstanding contributions to society. 

It serves as a platform for encouraging individuals and organizations to engage in meaningful social work. 

The award not only honors achievements but also fosters a spirit of community service and volunteerism. 

The Gaurav Puraskar Award is a shining example of how recognition can lead to greater societal impact.
